raw.details:
Guidelines

  • Eligibility: Open to college students interested in robotics, electronics, automation, and autonomous systems.
  • Team Size: Each team must consist of 2–4 members.
  • Inter-college Teams: Members from different colleges may participate as a team, subject to organiser approval.
  • Inter-specialization Teams: Students from different engineering specializations/branches may form a team.
  • Event Type: Robotics competition based on an autonomous line-following robot.
  • Challenge: Participants must design and operate an autonomous bot capable of following a predefined track while navigating turns and track variations with speed, precision, and accuracy.
  • Number of Problem Statements: One main line-following challenge/track is conducted, with the robot being evaluated based on its performance on the given track.
  • Duration: The event duration is 3 hours.
  • Maximum Teams: 24 teams can participate.
  • Event Date: 14–16 October 2026; the Line Follower slot is scheduled for 5:00 PM–8:00 PM on 14 October 2026.
  • Registration: Registration requires organiser approval. The registration fee is ₹200 per team, payable online by the team lead.

Rules

  • The robot must be autonomous and should follow the designated track without manual control.
  • Participants must bring/build a robot capable of detecting and following the given line.
  • The robot must remain within the designated track/path while completing the course.
  • Teams must follow the track and instructions provided by the event organisers.
  • Any form of external/manual intervention during the run may result in penalties or disqualification, as per the official rulebook.
  • Teams must ensure that their robot complies with the technical and safety requirements specified by the organisers.
  • Only registered team members are permitted to participate in the competition.
  • Participants must report to the venue before their allotted time and follow the instructions of the event coordinators.
  • The organisers reserve the right to modify the track, timings, or competition procedure if required.
  • The decision of the event coordinators/judges regarding competition results and rule violations will be final.
  • Participants are expected to maintain proper discipline and ensure that their activities do not cause damage to the venue, track, equipment, or other teams' robots.
